description: This file defines a logging utility class 'Log' with methods for logging info, warnings, errors, documentation issues, and other messages, including support for colored output based on OS.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A logging utility class for managing and printing log messages with different severity levels and optional colored output.

methods.name: __Print
methods.description: Internal method to print text, optionally with a file prefix.

methods.name: InfoLine
methods.description: Logs an informational message with line and file context from an object.

methods.name: WarnLine
methods.description: Logs a warning message with line and file context from an object.

methods.name: Dump
methods.description: Outputs all accumulated errors, warnings, and info messages.

methods.name: Header
methods.description: Logs a header message indicating processing of a file.

methods.name: Ellipsis
methods.description: Shortens a text string with ellipsis, front or back.
